title: Dao–Ru–Fo symbolic space
description: A symbolic space of tradition nodes, comparative relations and a curatorial encounter point; it uses no real-world coordinates.
disclaimer: Symbolic space is not a real map and does not collapse Daoist, Confucian and Buddhist cosmologies into one system.
